name: Symmetric Pseudo-Inverse Calculation
definition: Computes the pseudoinverse of a symmetric matrix A given its SVD (V and diagonal D). It inverts the eigenvalues in D, handling near-zero values via a threshold.
summary: Symmetric Pseudo-Inverse Calculation computes the pseudoinverse of a symmetric matrix via eigen-decomposition, distinguishing itself by exploiting symmetry for a direct, stable solution rather than iterative approximation.
